usedFor: Shopify holds the store orders and Billsby holds subscription billing, so “Order Cancelled” can update a customer through “Update Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update Customer” in Billsby
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is a reason to refresh the customer's record, and the action updates contact and billing details.

watchOut: “Create One-Time Charge” bills a customer and creates an invoice, so keep it off “Order Cancelled”.
